Sadece publish:true olanlar sayfaya girer; --all ile hepsi yerel onizlemede islenir. style: ugc | product | motion | ads | posters | marketplace. slug public URL olur, slug'a marka/musteri adi yazma (baslik ve aciklamada dukkan adi olabilir). loop_start/loop_len duvardaki hareketli WebP dongusunun araligi (sn).

hero._not: Banner: bitmis video (dikey tercih) + ondan cekim kareleri + ayni isin kaynak urun fotografi. Eslesen urun fotografi yok, foto yuvasi ikon olarak kalir.
hero.alt: Gelato launch video, a cup of roasted fig gelato flying over a tennis court

items.title: Modern Oval Solitaire
items.desc: Twenty-second ring film for The Lanes Jewellery Co. in Brighton. Nothing was filmed: every shot was made from their product photos of the ring, in yellow, rose and white gold.

items.title: Dehumidifier, room to room
items.desc: Thirty-second product film for a dehumidifier, made for Top en Toppie, a Dutch webshop. Nothing was filmed: the shots were made from the shop's product photos, the captions are in Dutch and the end card is their own photo.

items.title: Square watch on black
items.desc: Sixteen-second watch film for Tierelantijn, a shop in Breda. Eight shots on black, from the bracelet links to the green dial, all made from the four product photos on their website.

items.title: Pumpkin scented candle
items.desc: Eighteen-second sample for Es & Sie, a candle maker in Friesland, made from the photos on their website. The captions are in Dutch.

items.title: Velvet dog harness set
items.desc: Twenty-second sample for Soof's Pet Supplies, made from their product and campaign photos. The captions are in Dutch.

items.title: 40 Winks bedtime tea
items.desc: Thirty-second film for Skin Solace's 40 Winks loose leaf tea, made from a single product photo. Shown with the sample watermark.

items.title: Duck handle umbrella in the rain
items.desc: Thirty-second sample for Kindf_olk in Galway: an Original Duckhead umbrella, made from three product photos. Shown with the sample watermark.

items.title: Beech bed frame
items.desc: Short film for The Fine Store's Cubico bed frame by RYE, made from five product images. The ceiling, the floor and the evening light were added. Shown with the sample watermark.

items.title: Your dog on a hoodie
items.desc: Fifteen-second sample for Ted's Nook, made from the photos on their website. The captions are in Dutch. Shown with the sample watermark.

items.title: Slogan hoodies
items.desc: Fifteen-second sample for Home, Gifts & More, made from their hoodie product photos. The captions are in Dutch. Shown with the sample watermark.

items.title: Fig gelato launch
items.desc: Launch ad for a roasted fig gelato. The tub is wrapped in tennis-ball felt and set on a grass court, with hand-drawn doodles, a splash shot and a balloon-letter end card.

items.title: Headphones spot
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for over-ear headphones, made to show the style and not commissioned by the brand. Splash and dust shots sit under each feature line, then a leather car seat holds the end card.
items.check: Marshall logosu ve 'The Major V' yazisi gorunuyor (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle yayinda.

items.title: Blender pro mode demo
items.desc: A presenter shows a blender's pro setting in 11 seconds. Two buttons, a smooth green smoothie, then the pour. Shot to look like a phone video for TikTok and Reels.

items.title: Watch exploded view
items.desc: The watch comes apart layer by layer while callouts name the specs: 28,800 beats per hour, fully mechanical, 9H sapphire. It closes on the assembled watch and the wordmark.

items.title: Rock to ring
items.desc: One unbroken transformation. A mossy rock cracks open, crystals grow out of it and the last piece turns into a solitaire ring.

items.title: Smoked chilli oil
items.desc: Ingredient story for a smoked chilli oil. Sun-dried chillies and seeds over hot coals lead up to the bottle floating in open sky.

items.title: Face roller how-to
items.desc: A presenter shows how to use a sonic face roller in 14 seconds. Upward strokes, the forehead, a light touch under the eyes. Filmed as a bathroom mirror video.
items.check: Senaryo kisisel deneyim iddiasi iceriyor ('changed my skin in two weeks'). Kullanici videonun kalmasini istedi; SSS cevabi ornek formatlari aciklayacak sekilde guncellendi.

items.title: Leash spiral
items.desc: A patterned dog leash coils into a spiral on a split yellow and blue set, then collar and leash sit together for the tagline. Five seconds, built to loop.

items.title: Diamond knot ring
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a gold and diamond ring, not commissioned by the brand. Macro shots on velvet and among floating stones, a hand-model close-up and an order-now end card.
items.check: Yuzukte 'Tiffany & Co.' yazisi (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle yayinda.

items.title: Calming dog treats
items.desc: Phone-style UGC for calming dog treats. The presenter sits on the sofa with an older golden retriever and holds the pack up to camera.
items.check: Videoda 'AI-GENERATED PORTFOLIO DEMO - DEEP MIST AI' bandi var ve kullanici Deep Mist AI'in kendisi olmadigini soyledi (2026-09-29). Baskasinin imzasini kirpip kendi isimiz gibi yayinlamiyoruz; kaynagi netlesirse crop ile acilabilir.

items.title: Necklace unboxing
items.desc: Top-down unboxing, hands only. The gift box opens on a paper-cut night sky and the key pendant is lifted out and laid on silk.

items.title: Collar and leash with a cartoon dog
items.desc: Close-ups of a collar and leash cut together with a hand-drawn dog that runs the walk route. Sniff and repeat pop up as animated type.

items.title: SaaS product explainer
items.label: Explainer
items.desc: A 73-second talking-head explainer for a platform that takes AI-built apps to production. The presenter is cut with screen recordings, big type and captions on every line.
items.check: Nometria urununu anlatiyor (gercek sirket). Kullanici kendi uretimi dedi.

items.title: Steel chronograph reveal
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a steel chronograph, not commissioned by the brand. The watch starts as an outline in the dark, the bracelet and bezel get their own macro shots, then the dial lights up.
items.check: Kadranda Rolex yazisi ve tac logosu (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle.

items.title: Three-stone ring build
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a three-stone diamond ring, not commissioned by the brand. The centre stone drops into its setting, the camera runs along the engraved band and ends on the full ring against deep blue.
items.check: Yuzugun icinde GRAFF yazisi (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle.

items.title: Woven leather duffle
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a woven leather duffle, not commissioned by the brand. Hard cuts on a white studio set: the weave up close, the zip pull, the open bag from above and the bag carried on the shoulder.
items.check: Urun Bottega Veneta Intrecciato canta (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle. Bir karede basi gorunmeyen erkek manken var.

items.title: Rose gold watch on a model
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a rose gold diamond watch, not commissioned by the brand. A model wears it against a red backdrop, then the watch is held up to the camera and laid flat.
items.check: Kadranda PIAGET yazisi (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle. Kadin manken var.

items.title: Serpent bracelet macro
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a gold and diamond serpent bracelet, not commissioned by the brand. Macro passes over the head, the pavé stones and the coiled band on black, then the whole piece turns.
items.check: Urun Bulgari Serpenti (gercek marka tasarimi). Spec ad etiketiyle.

items.title: Quilted bag in the atelier
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a quilted leather bag, not commissioned by the brand. It follows the making in a sunlit workshop: the hide laid out, the cut, the stitching, and gloved hands fixing the charms on the finished bag.
items.check: Cantada DIOR harf sussleri (Lady Dior, gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle.

items.title: Gold watch details
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a gold-tone steel watch, not commissioned by the brand. Ten seconds of macro: the hands, the brushed dial, the bracelet links, then the full watch.
items.check: Kadranda CASIO yazisi (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle.

items.title: Nail bracelet spot
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a rose gold nail bracelet, not commissioned by the brand. The bracelet turns on black with a title line, a macro pass over the nail head, one shot on a wrist and a closing card.
items.check: Urun Cartier Juste un Clou, bir karede adi yaziyor (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle.

items.title: Street look with three accessories
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for sunglasses, a watch and a necklace in one shot, not commissioned by the brands. A model walks a city street while the camera moves in on each piece in turn.
items.check: Saatte CHANEL yazisi, gozluk Cartier panter tasarimi (gercek markalar). Spec ad etiketiyle. Sarisin kadin manken var.

items.title: Green dial automatic
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a steel automatic with a green dial, not commissioned by the brand. Crown, case back and bracelet in low light, then the dial fills the frame.
items.check: Kadranda FRANKLORD yazisi (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle.

items.title: Rose gold diamond band
items.desc: Ten-second product film for a rose gold ring. Soft-focus macro along the band and the diamond clusters, then the whole ring on a warm beige set.
items.check: Marka gorunmuyor.

items.title: Moonphase chronograph
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a moonphase chronograph on a leather strap, not commissioned by the brand. Dial macro, the case in profile, the moonphase disc and the watch upright on a grey set.
items.check: Kadranda PATEK PHILIPPE GENEVE yazisi (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle.

items.title: Knot sandals on a model
items.desc: Twelve-second product film for tan leather knot sandals. A model in a red dress shows them seated, standing and in close-up on a plain studio set.
items.check: Marka gorunmuyor. Kizil sacli kadin manken var.

items.title: Fragrance in low light
items.label: Spec ad
items.desc: Spec ad for a men's fragrance, not commissioned by the brand. The bottle comes out of the dark, a model in a black coat holds it up, and the label lights for the last shot.
items.check: Sisede BLEU DE CHANEL yazisi (gercek marka). Spec ad etiketiyle. Erkek manken var.

items.title: Poolside serum
items.check: Kylie Jenner'e benzeyen model + KYLIE SKIN sisesi. Gercek kisinin izinsiz reklami (right of publicity): yayinlanmaz.

items.title: Court spot
items.check: LeBron James'e benzeyen oyuncu, Lakers 23 formasi, Stanley termos. Gercek kisinin izinsiz reklami: yayinlanmaz.
